errors: verifier_unresolved:action:The action 'appropriate tests for ovarian cancer' is deliberately vague in the NICE text and refers to recommendations 1.5.6–1.5.9. None of the supplied candidates adequately represent this: CA-125 alone is too narrow (it is one of several tests), transvaginal ultrasound aspiration of ovarian cyst is a therapeutic/diagnostic procedure not a screening test, laparotomy for staging is far too invasive and specific, and pelvic vessel ultrasound is not the right concept. A broader investigation or assessment concept is needed.

verifier_unresolved:action:None of the action candidates correspond to serum CA125 measurement. All candidates are measurements of unrelated serum substances (ferritin, pseudocholinesterase, cholecystokinin, phenobarbitone, albumin). Selecting any of these would be clinically dangerous as the wrong test would be ordered.

errors: verifier_unresolved:n6:No suitable candidate provided. Supplied options are either unrelated (unexplained cough, infertility, falls) or too specific (metatarsal fracture). Need a general fracture concept suitable for unexplained/pathological fractures in myeloma context.

verifier_unresolved:action:The NICE recommendation specifies a multi-component investigation panel (FBC + calcium + viscosity/ESR + paraprotein + free light chains ± Bence-Jones). No single candidate captures this complete assessment. Candidates provided are either partial (FBC alone, serum protein electrophoresis alone) or unrelated (geriatric/frailty assessments). A myeloma-specific investigation panel concept or a composite procedure concept is needed.

results.chapter_title: Recommendations organised by site of cancer
errors: verifier_unresolved:n1:All candidates are individual laboratory observable entities (kappa/lambda free light chains, serum protein electrophoresis, paraprotein profile). The NICE criterion refers to 'results of the blood tests outlined in recommendation 1.10.4 suggest myeloma' — a collective abnormal pattern or clinical interpretation pointing toward myeloma, not a single test observable. Selecting serum protein electrophoresis alone (Model B) would misrepresent the multi-test criterion and is clinically unsafe. A concept representing suspected myeloma or abnormal myeloma-related blood results is needed.

verifier_unresolved:action:No myeloma-specific fast track referral concept is present among the candidates. The top candidate (276521000000103) is for sarcoma — clinically unsafe and changes the meaning. 'Fast track cancer referral' (199251000000107) is overly generic and does not capture the myeloma-specific suspected cancer pathway referral. A myeloma-specific or haematological cancer fast track referral concept is required.
